## Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) Receives Recognition as Top 100 Local Chapter by SWAYAM-NPTEL for Outstanding Performance in Online Certification Courses

News Date : 17 Feb 2023News ReportMahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) in Hyderabad, Telangana, has been recognized by SWAYAM-NPTEL as one of the top 100 local chapters for its excellent performance in NPTEL Online Certification Courses from July to December 2022. With a rating of A, MGIT has proven its dedication to providing quality education to its students. This achievement is a testament to the hard work and commitment of the faculty and students. Congratulations to the MGIT community for this outstanding accomplishment!
